tools.name: portfolio-analytics_performance-twr-mwr
tools.description: Compute linked TWR, Modified Dietz and XIRR from valuations and external cash flows, with optional annualisation. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/portfolio-analytics/performance-twr-mwr Keywords: when analysing portfolio risk or weights, valuations, flows, annualize, twr, modifiedDietz, xirr

tools.name: portfolio-analytics_risk-metrics
tools.description: Annualised volatility, Sharpe, Sortino, Calmar, max drawdown with peak/trough/recovery indices, skewness and excess kurtosis from a return series. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/portfolio-analytics/risk-metrics Keywords: when analysing portfolio risk or weights, returns, periodsPerYear, ris

tools.name: portfolio-analytics_var-cvar
tools.description: Historical, parametric normal and Monte Carlo VaR/ES at caller confidence levels from a return series. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/portfolio-analytics/var-cvar Keywords: when analysing portfolio risk or weights, returns, confidence, methods, portfolioValue, horizonPeriods, simulations, s

tools.name: portfolio-analytics_brinson-attribution
tools.description: Allocation, selection and interaction effects by segment for one or more periods, with optional Carino linking. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/portfolio-analytics/brinson-attribution Keywords: when analysing portfolio risk or weights, periods, linking, normalizeWeights, allowNegativeWeights

tools.name: portfolio-analytics_factor-regression
tools.description: OLS of portfolio excess returns on caller-supplied factors with intercept, betas, alpha and optional Newey-West standard errors. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/portfolio-analytics/factor-regression Keywords: when analysing portfolio risk or weights, returns, factors, riskFree, periodsPerYea

tools.name: portfolio-analytics_mean-variance-optimize
tools.description: Minimum variance, target return, max Sharpe or target volatility portfolios from expected returns and a covariance matrix, with bounds. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/portfolio-analytics/mean-variance-optimize Keywords: when analysing portfolio risk or weights, assets, expectedReturns, obje

tools.name: portfolio-analytics_risk-parity-weights
tools.description: Spinu ERC (or caller risk-budget) weights and inverse-volatility weights with risk-contribution breakdown. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/portfolio-analytics/risk-parity-weights Keywords: when analysing portfolio risk or weights, assets, covariance, riskBudget, method, weights, riskContribu

tools.name: portfolio-analytics_rebalance-trades
tools.description: Compute buys and sells that restore target weights with tolerance bands, a cash buffer, minimum trade size and whole-share rounding. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/portfolio-analytics/rebalance-trades Keywords: when analysing portfolio risk or weights, holdings, targets, cash, band, cashBuf

tools.name: portfolio-analytics_correlation-matrix
tools.description: Pearson and Spearman correlation, optional covariance, rolling windows and Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage covariance from caller series. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/portfolio-analytics/correlation-matrix Keywords: when analysing portfolio risk or weights, series, methods, missing, rollingWindow,

tools.name: portfolio-analytics_stress-test
tools.description: Apply caller-defined asset-class, factor and rate shocks to holdings and report P/L by holding and in total. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/portfolio-analytics/stress-test Keywords: when analysing portfolio risk or weights, holdings, scenarios, Scenario stress test on holdings, stress test,

tools.name: portfolio-analytics_monte-carlo-goal
tools.description: Project a contribution/withdrawal plan with mulberry32 Monte Carlo paths and report success probability and terminal wealth percentiles. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/portfolio-analytics/monte-carlo-goal Keywords: when analysing portfolio risk or weights, startValue, years, meanReturn, vol

tools.name: portfolio-analytics_wash-sale-detect
tools.description: Flag IRC §1091 wash sales in caller transactions with FIFO lots, disallowed losses and replacement basis adjustments per IRS Publication 550. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/portfolio-analytics/wash-sale-detect Keywords: when analysing portfolio risk or weights, transactions, identicalGroups

tools.name: portfolio-analytics_fee-drag-project
tools.description: Compare terminal wealth with and without expense ratios, advisory fees and loads under multiplicative or subtractive fee methods. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/portfolio-analytics/fee-drag-project Keywords: when analysing portfolio risk or weights, initial, years, grossReturn, annualContri

tools.name: portfolio-analytics_tracking-error-capture
tools.description: Tracking error, information ratio, up/down capture, batting average and optional active share versus a benchmark. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/portfolio-analytics/tracking-error-capture Keywords: when analysing portfolio risk or weights, benchmark, periodsPerYear, holdings, captureMethod,

tools.description: Aggregate caller-supplied fund look-through holdings by asset class, sector, region and top underlying positions.
